summary: LAGO Evergreen Credit filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a September 24, 2026 Fourth Amendment to its Loan and Security Agreement among LAGO Evergreen SPE, LLC as borrower, the Company as servicer and originator, LAGO Asset Management as investment manager, lenders, and KeyBank as Agent. The amendment raises available lender commitments from $125 million to $175 million, adds MUFG Bank as a new lender, and expands Eligible Note Receivables to include middle-market loans subject to eligibility and concentration limits. Borrowing stays subject to Investment Company Act leverage restrictions. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch portfolio ramp and leverage capacity.
